responsibility: This file implements GNU Modula-2's small fixed-arity varargs container for the mc-boot runtime. It owns the concrete vararg record that packs up to four argument byte sequences plus per-argument lengths and a current-position index, and provides constructors that copy one to four unbounded-array arguments into owned storage, sequential extraction and replacement with strict size checking, cursor repositioning, duplication of the packed argument block, argument counting, and destruction via Storage, giving higher-level runtime code a simple language-level substitute for C variadic argument handling.
same_name_distinction: Implements the varargs facility declared in Gvarargs.h by defining the concrete packed vararg record, owned backing storage, and the constructor/copy/access/replace/destruction logic for up to four stored argument byte sequences.
